name: Pop's Food Bus
address: 1717 N Andrews Avenue Extension #2, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33311, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Dr. Peck
reviewSamples.text: Service and workers are beyond friendly. Food is just ok for me. When you say combo on your menu, I think of a side and a possible drink. Unfortunately, that wasn’t the case. Paid $30 for mid quality food.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of NIDIA BATREZ
reviewSamples.text: My family and I love the ribs from this place. I have not tried the other items on the menu but the  ribs keep me coming back. It is not the cheapest, however, it is a small business and taste is worth it. You must try them!
